# Temple Scroll Column 36 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** 11QT (Cave 11), Col. 36 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**36:1** You shall make places to the east of the temple city, separated from it — for those with skin diseases.

**36:2** They shall dwell there alone and shall not enter the temple city.

**36:3** You shall make places to the north of the temple city for all who have discharges: the man with a discharge and the man with an emission of seed.

**36:4** They shall dwell there until the day of their purification; they shall not enter the temple city in their uncleanness.

**36:5** You shall make a place to the west of the temple city for women in the days of their menstrual impurity.

**36:6** They shall not enter My temple city, nor shall they defile My temple city in which I dwell.

**36:7** For I the LORD dwell in the midst of the sons of Israel forever and always.

**36:8** Every man who purifies himself from a skin disease shall bring the offering of his purification before he enters the temple city.

**36:9** The priest shall examine him outside the city; and if the disease has departed from him, the priest shall pronounce him clean.

**36:10** On the eighth day he shall bring his guilt offering, his sin offering, and his burnt offering according to the instruction.

**36:11** The man with a discharge — when his discharge ceases, he shall count seven days for his purification.

**36:12** On the eighth day he shall wash his garments and bathe his body in living water; and he shall be clean.

**36:13** After that he may enter the temple city; and he shall bring his offering to the LORD — two turtledoves or two young pigeons: one for a sin offering and one for a burnt offering.

**36:14** The priest shall make atonement for him before the LORD for his discharge; and he shall be clean.

**36:15** The sons of Israel shall keep themselves separate from all uncleanness; and they shall not defile the land in which I dwell.

**36:16** For I the LORD dwell in the midst of the sons of Israel; and the land shall be holy.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus follows EMET closely for this column. "Living water" preserved over "flowing/running water." "Pronounce him clean" preferred over "declare him clean" for its traditional biblical ring. "Menstrual impurity" adopted from LOGOS as more precise than EMET's "impurity" alone.*
